Title: Opening Remarks
Blurb: Join us to kick off MCN 2025 with remarks from the MCN board and the MCN 2025 program committee. Following the remarks will be a discussion between Jonathan Munar, MCN board member and program chair, and Paul Marty, associate vice provost for academic innovation at Florida State University and co-author of the recent book, Invisible History of Museum Computing (American Alliance of Museums, 2025).
